name: Class 483
manufacturer: British Rail Engineering, ABB, Metro-Cammell, Alstom
description: The British Rail Class 465 Networker are electric multiple unit passenger trains that were built by Metro-Cammell, GEC-Alsthom, British Rail Engineering Limited (BREL) and ABB Rail between 1991 and 1994. Originally operated by Network SouthEast,[6] these units are now operated by Southeastern.
